jobs.description:
### **Overview**

The Global Seller Onboarding team works directly with sellers and internal teams to ensure they are able to take full advantage of Square's products and services. Global Seller Onboarding Specialists work closely with teams within Sales & Account Management as well as Product Specialists and Product Marketing Managers to deliver a seamless and exceptional merchant experience and give key input into the product roadmaps for customer-facing developer products. Additionally, Global Seller Onboarding Specialists play a key role in merchant discovery and lead the final stages of the sale, working with Square's upmarket sellers and cross-functional teams to successfully implement and activate new accounts.

Square initially pioneered the simple self-service model to enable small businesses to take a payment. Now, we aspire to expand that same seamless experience up-market. This position will play a pivotal role in establishing seller success needed for us to drive growth, retention, and scale our services up-market. We're working to find new and better ways to help businesses succeed on their own terms—and we're looking for people like you to help shape tomorrow at Square.

**Seller Onboarding Expert - L3 (IC)**

**You Will (Responsibilities):**

### **Strategic Onboarding & Education (Estimated 70% of work)**

* Guide sellers (customers) to start transacting with Square quickly and with confidence, delivering high-quality onboarding and implementation experiences for Square's SMB and mid-market sellers
* Lead seller-facing scoping and onboarding calls, help sellers along their onboarding journey by delivering tailored, necessary training content, and support sellers after they begin transacting with Square
* Learn and maintain a strong understanding of relevant product features and releases
* Execute onboarding best practices consistently while escalating complex product or technical needs.
* Balance the needs of numerous (20-30) sellers at any given time, ensuring successful completion of each onboarding engagement

### **Project / Process Execution (Estimated 20% of work)**

* Identify issues or blockers that could affect a seller's onboarding experience or go-live date, and escalate appropriately to senior team members or cross-functional partners.
* Contribute to improvements in onboarding processes by documenting gaps, proposing refinements, and sharing observations from seller engagements.
* Maintain clear, proactive communication with assigned sellers and demonstrate the ability to maintain an onboarding tracker with key milestones, target dates, and next steps to keep sellers informed and on track for go-live.
* Help sellers understand and complete the steps required for launch, following up on outstanding needs and confirming readiness ahead of their target go-live date.
* Use AI to improve the seller experience and automate or enhance internal processes.

### **Team Collaboration & Skill Development (Estimated 10% of work)**

* Share best practices with peers and contribute to a positive team culture.
* Take ownership of keeping product knowledge current, including new features, updates, and known limitations, to provide sellers with accurate guidance.
* Support team knowledge areas (POS, Online, integrations) by developing product expertise and serving as a go-to resource for standard questions.
* Participate in internal meetings, training, roadmap updates, and optimization discussions to build broader product and organizational understanding.
* Escalate product, process, or policy issues clearly and promptly to senior teammates and product teams; assist in resolving routine internal or client concerns.
* Demonstrate reliability and consistency in onboarding execution while learning to manage more complex workflows.
* Comfortable working in a high-volume, high-tempo, customer-focused onboarding environment.
  

**You Have (Qualifications):**

* 2–4+ years of experience in onboarding, implementation, operations, or account management customer support, customer success; relevant industry experience (restaurant, services, retail) is a plus.
* Demonstrated strong performance and consistency in onboarding work (metrics, CSAT, responsiveness, quality).
* Experience managing multiple onboarding projects simultaneously with reliable delivery.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; professionalism in client and stakeholder interactions.
* Proactive attitude and eagerness to learn; ability to apply feedback quickly.
* Strong time-management and organizational skills.
* Comfort operating through change and ambiguity with appropriate support.
* Familiarity with project management practices.
* Basic understanding of data analysis or reporting tools (Looker, Salesforce, etc.) is a plus.
* Strong understanding and consistent usage of AI tools and platforms

jobs.title: Implementation Engineer
jobs.description:
At Expel, signing a new customer is just the beginning. The real magic happens when we turn that excitement into a seamless onboarding experience, working integrations, confident security teams, and a customer who's ready to get the most out of our platform.

That's where you come in.

As an Implementation Engineer, you'll own the first 30–60 days of the customer journey, taking customers from their initial sales handoff through technical implementation, enablement, and their first real value with Expel.

This isn't just about configuring tools or checking boxes. You'll be the person bringing everything together, helping customers navigate technical challenges, keeping implementations on track, and making sure they're set up for success long after onboarding is complete.

You'll work closely with customers, our Security Operations Center (SOC), Customer Success, and internal technical teams to deliver an onboarding experience that's thoughtful, efficient, and built around each customer's environment.

**What Expel can do for you:**
------------------------------

* Give you ownership of the customer onboarding experience, from initial handoff through successful implementation and transition to Customer Success.
* Provide opportunities to work with a variety of enterprise security environments, technologies, and customer challenges.
* Connect you with experienced security practitioners across our SOC, engineering, and customer-facing teams.
* Give you a voice in improving how we onboard customers, streamline processes, and deliver value faster.
* Help you continue developing your technical expertise across cybersecurity, cloud environments, and Expel's Workbench platform.
* Offer a remote work environment where you can collaborate across teams while taking ownership of your work.

**What you can do for Expel:**
------------------------------

* **Own the customer onboarding journey.** Manage a portfolio of 15–20+ implementations simultaneously, guiding customers from post-sale handoff through technical setup, enablement, and initial value.
* **Bring customers live with confidence.** Lead technical onboarding, including security integrations, configurations, Workbench training, custom setup, and incident simulations.
* **Help customers get the most out of Expel.** Partner with our SOC to validate customer configurations and ensure they're positioned to detect and respond to real threats.
* **Keep implementations moving.** Establish clear timelines, communicate expectations, manage milestones, and hold customers accountable while maintaining strong relationships.
* **Get ahead of potential issues.** Identify technical blockers, customer readiness gaps, and slipping timelines early, escalating when necessary to prevent onboarding delays and future retention risks.
* **Make customer transitions seamless.** Partner closely with Customer Success to ensure every handoff includes the technical context, customer expectations, and documentation needed for long-term success.
* **Help us continuously improve.** Identify recurring onboarding challenges, provide feedback to Product and internal teams, and recommend improvements that reduce friction and accelerate time-to-value.
* **Support the broader team.** Maintain accurate implementation documentation and provide technical guidance to associate-level teammates when needed.

**What You Should Bring With You**
----------------------------------

* 2+ years of experience implementing SaaS solutions, security services, or IT services within enterprise environments.
* Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Implementation Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Technical Support, or Professional Services.
* Working knowledge of cybersecurity technologies, including EDR, SIEM, NDR, and CASB, and how these tools support enterprise security operations.
* A solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including the OSI model, DNS, firewalls, and proxies, particularly as they relate to security integrations and deployments.
* Familiarity with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and their native security services.
* Understanding of enterprise security best practices and common compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA.
* The technical troubleshooting skills to trace data flows, identify integration issues, and work through challenges between a customer's environment and Expel's platform.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to translate technical concepts for security practitioners, business stakeholders, and customers.
* Experience managing multiple customer implementations or technical projects simultaneously, keeping priorities organized and timelines on track.
* The confidence to set expectations, navigate difficult conversations, and hold customers accountable while maintaining positive relationships.
* Good judgment around when to troubleshoot independently, when to escalate, and how to adapt when a customer's environment doesn't fit the standard playbook.
* A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

**Additional Notes**
--------------------

The base salary range for this role is between $93,900 USD and $136,200 USD, with a target range of $104,000 to $126,500, plus bonus eligibility and equity.

We believe in paying transparently and equitably. Your salary will ultimately be based on factors such as your experience, skills, team equity, and market data. You'll also be eligible for unlimited PTO (which we model and encourage), work location flexibility, up to 24 weeks of parental leave, and really excellent health benefits.

We're only hiring those authorized to work in the United States. We do not currently sponsor immigration visas.

We're an Equal Opportunity Employer: You'll receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

We'll ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please let us know if you need accommodation of any kind.

jobs.title: Recruiting and Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
TalkNY Therapy (TalkNYC Psychotherapy, Mental Health Counseling) is a provider of

psychotherapy and group therapy services, primarily carried out on a virtual (teletherapy) basis,

to patients located within New York. Our network of licensed therapists are specialized in various

areas of mental health, and we strive to make mental health care accessible and convenient for

our clients.

We are seeking a detail-oriented, forward-thinking, and highly organized individual to join our

team as a Recruiting and Onboarding Specialist. The Recruiting and Onboarding Specialist will

manage the full recruitment cycle while ensuring a smooth, welcoming, and efficient onboarding

experience for new hires. This individual will work closely with candidates, new hires, and

administrative staff. The ideal candidate will possess excellent communication skills, the ability

to multitask and be comfortable working in a fast-growth environment.

Key Responsibilities:

Recruiting

* Manage job postings across platforms (Indeed, LinkedIn, etc.)
* Proactively source candidates across all platforms
* Review resumes and screen candidates
* Build and maintain a pipeline of prospective candidates for current and upcoming roles
* Coordinate and schedule interviews
* Communicate with candidates throughout the hiring process
* Partner with hiring managers to move candidates through the pipeline
* Track and report on hiring metrics (applications, interviews, offers)

Onboarding

* Coordinate onboarding for all new hires
* Send offer letters and collect required documentation
* Ensure completion of onboarding tasks (I-9, credentials, compliance forms)
* Set up new hires in internal systems (EHR, email, etc.)
* Facilitate a smooth onboarding experience
* Act as a point of contact for new hires during onboarding

Qualifications:

* Prior experience in recruiting, onboarding, or a similar role, preferably in a healthcare or

mental health setting

* Proficiency in using applicant tracking systems or HR softwares and other office tools

(e.g., Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace)

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple roles and priorities at once
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a remote work environment.

Compensation and Benefits:

* Compensation: $27/hour
* Work from home
* Full time

Physical Requirements:

This position primarily operates in an office environment. The role requires the ability to sit for

extended periods, use a computer and other standard office equipment, and occasionally lift or

move items up to 10–15 pounds. Some walking, bending, and standing may be required.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Talk NY is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color,

disability, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
